name: layout13
description: cozy autumn scrapbook collage / Pinterest fashion moodboard. Warm brown, caramel, beige, and cream color palette with soft natural daylight. Background is split vertically: left half layered with torn newspaper clippings and text fragments, right half showing a large plaid/tartan fabric swatch — detect the dominant color and style of the outfit from the uploaded image and adapt the plaid/tartan color family to match (e.g. brown knit outfit → brown tartan; green outfit → green plaid; navy outfit → navy tartan; pastel outfit → soft pastel plaid). Small polka dot strip runs along the very top edge in a muted accent color. The layout contains 3 photo slots: one large vertical portrait upper-left (half body, subject looking sideways), one overlapping secondary vertical portrait center-left below it (half body, different angle), one large foreground cutout lower-right with white silhouette outline (dominant subject, close-up face or upper body). Decorative elements include large editorial serif typography 'The Autumn' or season label integrated into upper-left photo area, brown coat button sticker (center), torn newspaper quote label 'happier than ever' (center-right), a plush toy or stuffed animal cutout (lower-left) — detect the aesthetic and outfit vibe from the uploaded image and choose a matching plush character (e.g. cozy knit outfit → Miffy bunny with scarf; sporty outfit → bear in jersey; girly/pink outfit → Hello Kitty plush; dark academia → owl or fox plush), Hello Kitty decorated Fujifilm digital camera cutout (center), chocolate chip cookie cutout (right), pretzel cutout (lower-center), ramen/noodle bowl cutout (lower-center), chat bubble 'God you're so pretty.' (lower-left), volume slider mobile UI overlay (lower-left), 'Select / Select All' mobile UI bar (center). Soft cozy atmosphere, knitwear fashion styling, autumn café mood. Follow the exact number, shape, scale hierarchy, overlap style, and arrangement of photo slots shown in the layout reference.
swipe_cta: Add a small kraft-paper label, chat bubble, or scrapbook sticker containing a short swipe-related CTA (such as 'Swipe →' or a similar concise variation). Keep the wording brief and cozy. Blend it naturally with the autumn-themed decorations, paper textures, and vintage scrapbook elements.
